description: Arkheionx heuristic calibration matrix for readiness finding families. This matrix documents confidence requirements, downgrade logic, common false positives, and manual review prompts.

high_confidence_requires: missing invariant or roundtrip test coverage
totalAssets, convertToShares, convertToAssets, or fee/strategy context
medium_confidence_requires: partial accounting or lifecycle test gap
low_confidence_conditions: ambiguous shares/assets terms without function context
downgrade_conditions: matching invariant or fuzz tests detected
explicit rounding, donation, or totalAssets assumptions documented
common_false_positives: documentation uses vault language for product planning
imported library handles accounting but local tests are elsewhere
recommended_manual_review: Check whether accounting invariants are implemented in inherited contracts
Check whether external strategies affect totalAssets

medium_confidence_requires: partial stale, bounds, or decimals coverage gap
low_confidence_conditions: price variable without external price source
downgrade_conditions: bounds, decimals, heartbeat, or TWAP assumptions documented and tested
common_false_positives: docs mention oracle but contract does not use one
oracle validation implemented in imported adapter
recommended_manual_review: Check whether spot prices can be moved in the same transaction

medium_confidence_requires: admin role terms in Solidity files
low_confidence_conditions: owner appears only in docs or tests
ambiguous operator variable with no setter
common_false_positives: deployment scripts not in runtime scope
recommended_manual_review: Check transferOwnership and role handoff behavior

high_confidence_requires: missing initializer or upgrade authorization tests
low_confidence_conditions: proxy term appears only in docs
common_false_positives: proxy references in deployment docs only
inherited upgradeable base with tests in another package

high_confidence_requires: Solidity external call or token transfer in withdraw/claim/refund path
missing reentrant receiver or double-claim tests
medium_confidence_requires: external call and value-flow terms in Solidity
low_confidence_conditions: transfer appears only in docs or tests
read-only external call with no state mutation
common_false_positives: documentation mentions reentrancy as a threat model item
recommended_manual_review: Check state update before external calls

high_confidence_requires: staking/reward state and claim function evidence
low_confidence_conditions: token name contains reward but no accounting logic
common_false_positives: simple fixed reward with external verified module

high_confidence_requires: no invariant or fuzz tests detected
accounting, oracle, value-flow, or privileged state context
medium_confidence_requires: tests exist but lack rule-pack coverage terms
low_confidence_conditions: generic repository with few Solidity signals
common_false_positives: tests live in a package ignored by scan config
invariant tests generated under nonstandard naming

medium_confidence_requires: partial docs with missing role/oracle/upgrade assumptions
low_confidence_conditions: docs exist but scanner cannot classify content
common_false_positives: README intentionally points to external docs

high_confidence_requires: missing invariant or slippage boundary tests
medium_confidence_requires: partial reserve or liquidity test gap

recommended_manual_review: Check oracle and interest index assumptions
Check source chain and sender validation
